title.zh: Solana客户端Firedancer引入漏洞提交费，每份报告须销毁1枚SOL
title.en: Solana客户端Firedancer引入漏洞提交费，每份报告须销毁1枚SOL

current_state.zh: Firedancer now requires researchers to permanently burn 1 SOL (~$100) per bug report — non-refundable even for duplicates or out-of-scope submissions — to curb AI-generated report spam, while temporarily doubling standard bounties and offering up to 3x (max $300k) for Alpenglow vulnerabilities until November 20.
